verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an extensive markdown-based API reference (bookings, event-types, schedules, webhooks, etc.) but no indication of an interactive console or 'try it' runnable examples; a direct probe for an OpenAPI/Swagger spec (which typically powers such interactivity) returned 404 on all candidate paths, suggesting no discoverable interactive spec. Missing for 10: any documented interactive 'try it now' UI, embedded code sandbox, or accessible OpenAPI spec enabling runnable requests directly from the docs.
